text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Did you watch my run properly!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even in a race full of such tough 
competitors, I managed to pull off great 
results!
choice_data_list: That was your best run yet!
That was your best run yet!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Honestly, I could feel the 
difference while running too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's not about times or finishing orders, 
you know...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's like... overcoming all sorts of 
things is what made my running what it is 
today.
choice_data_list: Did you feel how much you've grown?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Growth... Yeah, that might be the right 
word! I've grown so much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright... I'm definitely going to win the 
next race too. Without a shadow of a 
doubt...!

And so, Tokai Teio achieved a spectacular 
result at the Japan Cup.
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Trainer, come with me 
for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm heading over to the Prez right now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Just come on! Let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez! I need to talk to you!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I've been waiting for you, Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Were you waiting? ...For me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting—for you, this whole 
time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, Prez. Did you watch my Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Truly matchless valor... A race 
truly worthy of the title "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...You see, Teio. I have run upon the 
turf for my great ambition, for the ideals 
I must fulfill."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Right now, though—all that matters is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I want to run with you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume, and as Symboli Rudolf! I 
desire a race against Tokai Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this in the year-end grand 
finale, the Arima Kinen, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —...gh, yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I will... definitely become one, no matter 
what!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll become an "Empress" who surpasses the 
"Emperor"!!

The showdown with Symboli Rudolf at the 
year-end Arima Kinen is finally going to 
happen!
